recognize_zh: 左下方的白血球（核呈雙葉、細胞質略帶顆粒）內，箭頭所指為一個被透亮暈圈包圍、內含深染小體的圓形酵母菌，旁邊還有空泡；右上角另一顆白血球內也可見類似的圓形包涵體，符合被吞噬的有莢膜真菌（本例為隱球菌）。
features: Leukocyte (neutrophil or monocyte) with bilobed nucleus and finely granular cytoplasm
Arrowed round intracytoplasmic yeast with a defined wall, central dark-staining body and surrounding clear halo
Similar round inclusion with a halo in a second leukocyte at the upper right
Thick smear area with crenated, blurred red cells; platelets scattered
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with crenated red cells, shows leukocytes containing intracytoplasmic fungal organisms. A phagocyte with a bilobed nucleus contains a round yeast with a defined wall, central dark-staining material and a surrounding clear halo (arrow), with an adjacent vacuole; a similar organism is present in another leukocyte at the upper right. The halo suggests a capsule, although budding pattern cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with intracellular encapsulated yeasts, compatible with disseminated cryptococcal infection; confirmation by blood culture and cryptococcal antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Yeasts are smaller and more uniform, typically multiple per cell with a crescent nucleus, and lack a mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Display budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and no capsular halo.
Show a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast, usually within macrophages, and lack a clear capsule.
Are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus rather than round encapsulated yeasts.
